project_title: Quick Wing Landing Page Premium Refinement Blueprint

theme.concept: Warm Alabaster, Rich Obsidian Charcoal, Warm Cobalt Blue & Subtle Gold Recognition Accents

refinement_targets.issues_addressed: Removed 'Client' word beside Bluebird logo; warm, balanced editorial layout with subtle hover states and card-like distinction.

changes.content_js: Remove `Client` inside `data-testid="landing-trust-client"`. Restructure trust items into an aligned 3-card editorial grid with warm card surfaces, soft borders (`#E2DFD7`), and hover lifts (`transform: translateY(-2px)`).
changes.css: Update `#qw-landing .trust` to `background: #FAF8F5; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);`. Grid `#qw-landing .trust-in` set to `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.3fr 1.1fr; gap: 24px; align-items: stretch;`. Each item styled as elevated card with `background: #FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid var(--line)`, `padding: 20px 24px`, `border-radius: 8px`, `transition: all 200ms ease`. Client logo given crisp white background backdrop, `height: 48px; object-fit: contain;` without muddy filter.

refinement_targets.issues_addressed: Replaced cold/stale look with highly engaging, premium interactive dashboard showcase. Premium active tab state, warm cobalt indicator line, IBM Plex Mono index badges, and elevated preview stage with browser-bar header and soft ambient depth.

changes.content_js: Maintain 5 feature tabs switching live dashboard/booking/vehicles/reports/GPS screenshots with keyboard navigation support (Arrow keys, Home, End). Keep data-testid attributes intact (`landing-tab-*`, `landing-feature-preview`, `landing-tab-image`).
changes.css_tabs: #qw-landing .tab background set to `#FFFFFF` on hover and warm active fill `#EFECE6`. Active tab (`aria-selected='true'`) features a 3px left border accent in `var(--blue)` (`#1D5897`), text color `var(--ink)`, and subtle right chevron icon glow. Tab titles get `font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600;`. Descriptions get `font-size: 13px; color: var(--body);`.
changes.css_stage: #qw-landing .tab-stage styled with `background: #FAF8F5; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--preview_glow); overflow: hidden;`. Preview bar gets browser-window styling with 3 warm dot icons on left, brand pill `Quick Wing` in blue badge, and clean title. Preview image gets `border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); padding: 16px;`.

refinement_targets.issues_addressed: Warm, tactile touch targets for 7 mobile accordion disclosures (`<details className='mobile-section'>`). Smooth summary background highlight and clear plus/minus pill icon.

changes.css_mobile: Mobile summary `min-height: 84px; padding: 18px 20px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px;`. Summary title `font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);`. Hint `font-size: 12px; color: var(--body);`. Icon container `width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: #EFECE6; color: var(--blue);`. Open accordion changes summary header background to warm alabaster with subtle blue left accent bar.

refinement_targets.issues_addressed: Eradicates grey/pale-sage flatness across hero, stats, demo, award, pricing, ROI calculator, and footer.

changes.css_global: Update CSS variables in `LandingPage.css`: `--paper: #FAF8F5; --stone: #EFECE6; --ink: #181C1A; --body: #4A524D; --muted: #707872; --line: #E2DFD7; --blue: #1D5897; --focus: #2B6CB0;`. Buttons get soft rounded-md styling (4px), smooth hover micro-transitions, and elevated shadow on primary CTAs.

In `trust-item` for Bluebird Care, remove `Client` completely so the word 'Client' is no longer displayed beside Bluebird Care.
Ensure all asset paths (`/images/bluebird-care-logo.jpg`, `/images/ai-six-podcast.jpg`, `/images/hcci-logo.png`, screenshots) and testids remain strictly intact.
/app/frontend/src/pages/landing/LandingP: Refine `#qw-landing .trust-in` layout grid for desktop (3 equal cards with internal padding `20px 24px`, white card backgrounds, subtle borders, flex alignment for text and image logos).
Refine `#qw-landing .tabs-wrap` and `.tab` styling: rounded edges, active left border indicator (`border-left: 3px solid var(--blue)`), IBM Plex Mono number styling in blue/muted tone.
Refine `#qw-landing .tab-stage` frame: elevated box shadow, clean browser header bar with status dot indicators, rich screenshot shadow.
/app/frontend/src/pages/landing/MobileSe: Enhance summary touch target and card styling for collapsed accordion headers on mobile devices (`max-width: 767px`).
Add warm border and card fill to mobile summary headers to make them clearly tappable affordances.
/app/frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.js: Keep stable `useMemo` for `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` to prevent React 19 re-render DOM node recreation.

testing_and_accessibility.accessibility: Full WCAG AA contrast ratio compliance (> 4.5:1 for body text, > 3:1 for large headings & interactive elements). Keyboard navigation enabled for tabs (`ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Home`, `End`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Execute changes directly on target files: `/app/frontend/src/pages/landing/content.js`, `/app/frontend/src/pages/landing/LandingPage.css`, `/app/frontend/src/pages/landing/MobileSections.css`.
Do NOT alter mobile section default collapse behavior (<=767px collapsed, >=768px expanded).
Ensure the word 'Client' is removed from beside Bluebird logo in `content.js`.
Run frontend build / tests to verify visual rendering and testid stability after making updates.
